description:
Turn ACTION: lines in notes and logs into TASK: anchors, and edit those anchors in place. The source files are the only task store.

Subcommands:
  ingest [--dry-run] [--quiet] — rewrite every ACTION: line in notes/ and logs/ into a TASK: anchor with a new 8-char uuid. Running with no subcommand does the same.
  add THREAD TEXT [--due DATE] [--scheduled DATE] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID] — add an ACTION to the buffer. Same as `buffer add-action`.
  done UUID — mark a task complete: TASK becomes DONE, end:<today> is stamped
  set-description UUID TEXT — replace the task body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — replace the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set the due date
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set the scheduled date
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set the priority: H, M or L
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — make UUID wait on DEP_UUID
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove one dependency
  list [--priority H|M|L] [--thread T] [--assignee A] [--overdue] [--json] — list pending tasks, grouped by thread A-Z, then by priority, due date, entry date
  next — the top 5 pending tasks by priority, due date, entry date
  show UUID — show one task in detail

Args:
  UUID / DEP_UUID  task uuid from `list`; any unique prefix works. For rm-depends, DEP_UUID only has to match one of that task's own dependencies.
  THREAD           'Kind/Name', e.g. Projects/SGB
  TEXT (add)       '(Assignee) description' or just 'description'. The assignee must have a people/ file.
  PERSON           name with a people/<name>.md file; a 'people/' prefix is allowed
  DATE             YYYY-MM-DD

Flags:
  ingest:
    --dry-run          show what would be ingested; write nothing
    --quiet            no per-action output
  add:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD
    --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8    a task this one waits on. Repeatable: one flag per uuid.
  list:
    --priority H|M|L   one priority only
    --thread T         thread, e.g. Processes/SGB
    --assignee A       person name
    --overdue          only tasks due before today
    --json             JSON output

Examples:
  ["list", "--overdue", "--json"]
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-06-15"]

Notes:
  `add` only queues an ACTION in the buffer. It gets no uuid until `buffer flush`, which ingests it. Then get the uuid from `list`.
  ingest, done, set-*, add-depends and rm-depends rewrite note and log files in place. Never hand-edit TASK:/DONE: lines.
  Exit 1: no task matches the uuid prefix, empty prefix, malformed date, empty description, person not in people/, or a task made to depend on itself.
